regexWarning.title: No LLM parser available
regexWarning.body: No LLM (Ollama, OpenAI, Claude) is configured. The regex fallback only recognises the most common booking formats; manual corrections will be needed more often.

llmDisabled.title: AI parser switched off
llmDisabled.body: The administrator has switched the AI model off. Bookings are read with the built-in templates only; anything no template knows you fill in by hand.

email.pasteFirst: Paste the text of the e-mail first.

provider.local: Anything no template knows is read by the AI model {{model}} on your network.
provider.cloud: Anything no template knows is sent to {{host}} ({{model}}) to be read — a cloud provider outside this instance.

cloudNotConsented.title: AI parser awaiting consent
cloudNotConsented.body: The configured AI provider is outside the network, and the administrator has not agreed to sending bookings there. Bookings are read with the built-in templates only.

providerIncomplete.title: AI provider not fully set up
providerIncomplete.body: The OpenAI-compatible provider is missing its base URL or model. Until the administrator completes it, bookings are read with the built-in templates only.
